title: The Giver
author: Lois Lowry
current_text: In Palm Springs, a library clerk and principal objected to The Giver as inappropriate for a fourth-grade reading class and requested its removal from district elementary school libraries and classrooms; the school board upheld the assistant superintendent’s decision to remove it from those libraries and move it to middle school and high school libraries. In 1996, The Giver was challenged at Glacier Gateway Elementary School in Columbia Falls over questionable values and concerns that it would desensitize students to murder, suicide and infanticide; it was retained. In Elk Grove, an objector requested the removal of The Giver and other materials assigned to a seventh-grade class, alleging that they contained “negative situations” conflicting with “personal moral convictions” and claiming that they aimed to “brainwash” students.
